sloka: त्वया अविगण्य वातापे परिभूताः च तेजसा ।जीव लोके द्विज श्रेष्ठाः तस्मात् असि जराम् गतः ॥३-४३-४४॥
transliteration: tvayā avigaṇya vātāpe paribhūtāḥ ca tejasā ।jīva loke dvija śreṣṭhāḥ tasmāt asi jarām gataḥ ॥3-43-44॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana just like Vatapi, this demon will not live. Whoever violates a person of my kind who is ever righteous and selfcontrolled will be killed
